all four tmpfs targets and read-only root are present

limitations: This is static source and OCI metadata evidence, not a container runtime receipt.
The fixed image has no VISION_INDEX_CLEAN_START switch; freshness depends on the attested tmpfs and zero-count preflight.
The service has no drawing-list endpoint; exact post-index identities are bound by the receipt set plus authoritative count three.

Index-add creates an in-memory LocalEventBus even with EVENT_BUS_ENABLED=false; EVENT_BUS_USE_LOCAL=true and runtime inspection prevent a Redis path, and explicit rebuild remains required because no index handlers are registered.
The image reports three inconsistent version strings, so only the image digest and source revision identify the substrate.
No image pull, container start, fixture processing, model-quality evaluation, customer-data use, merge, deployment, decision enablement, or pilot is authorized by this attestation.
